CattleUSA: If you would like to buy online during our feeder sales it is broadcasted on CattleUSA. You need to be registed through CattleUSA AND Equity. Therefore, if you have not bought at an Equity barn please fill out our buyer application at any market or online and send it in at least a week prior to sale date. We then can approve you to buy through CattleUSA.
